briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 intensify multi-agent race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month with o4 leading multi-agent tasks. Global AI funding hit $14.8B in Q2 amid escalating US-China tensions. Prompt injection remains the dominant production risk.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with advanced agent orchestration. DeepSeek-R2 matched performance at lower cost while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus focused on constitutional alignment. xAI Grok-3 entered public beta.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra clusters shipping to Microsoft and Google. TSMC reported 3nm AI chip yields above 80%. New data center builds in Texas and UAE added 1.2 GW of capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier multi-agent deployments by 2028?
